intelligence.essence: Not just edge functions — the WHOLE of Supabase and the whole flow GitHub ↔ Supabase ↔ Cloudflare ↔ NayaNET as ONE bridge, like water. Every piece gets a KEEP / DROP / FIX verdict: should be there and used, should not be there at all, or causing errors and should be there (then fix the errors). The intelligent blocks are what it all serves — every piece must map to a block, a flow, the Vault or the Ledger; a piece serving nothing is the DROP case. And the map has a center: THE SMART VAULT LIVES IN SUPABASE. All intelligence is input into it and used from it — that is what Supabase is for. Every citizen has their OWN Smart Vault, functioning and working for each of them. A piece that serves no citizen's Vault and no flow is dead weight — DROP it, just let it go. The goal is fine-tuning for MAX PERFORMANCE when NayaNET is fully released to the world: nothing extra dragging it, nothing missing that it needs.
